content.user_title: Manage SoftSync Notes on Customer Records
content.value_statement: Customer context can become scattered when call summaries and updates are not attached to records. This skill guides note creation, editing, sharing, and deletion on SoftSync record timelines.
actual_capabilities: Create Markdown notes through the manage_notes tool.
Attach notes to company, contact, or deal records after looking up the target record.
Replace note text when the current user is the author.
Switch note visibility between private and shared with the workspace.
Delete notes when the current user is the author.
Direct note discovery through the messages skill using the notes source.
limitations: Requires an available manage_notes tool; this skill does not include its implementation.
Finding existing notes depends on the separate messages skill, and attachment requires record lookup.
Editing and deletion are documented as author-only operations; backend enforcement is not verifiable from this file.
No bulk operations, version history, or recovery workflow is documented.

use_cases.title: Capture Sales Call Context
use_cases.description: Record customer statements and next steps on the relevant deal timeline without adding unsupported facts.

use_cases.title: Maintain Account Notes
use_cases.description: Update authored notes on company records and share approved account context with workspace colleagues.

use_cases.title: Keep Private Contact Observations
use_cases.description: Attach private notes to contact records and adjust visibility when sharing is explicitly requested.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Private Note
prompt_templates.prompt: Find company [company name] and create a private note: [provided facts]. Use only these facts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: capture a single record note.

prompt_templates.title: Replace an Authored Note
prompt_templates.prompt: Find my note about [topic] on contact [contact name]. Replace its text with [replacement text] only if I am the author.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: locate and update an existing note.

prompt_templates.title: Share a Specific Note
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the private note titled [title] on deal [deal name]. Confirm the exact match with me, then share it with the workspace.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: change visibility for a selected note.

prompt_templates.title: Replace an Outdated Deal Note
prompt_templates.prompt: Find my outdated note about [topic] on deal [deal name]. Create a private replacement using [facts]. Confirm before deleting the original.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate discovery, creation, and author-only deletion.

output_examples.input: Draft a private company note from these facts: Acme requested a product demonstration. Follow up Tuesday.
Draft replacement text for my deal note: The customer asked for revised pricing. No purchase date was provided.
output: The customer asked for revised pricing.

best_practices: Look up the target record and resolve ambiguous matches before attaching a note.
Specify private or workspace visibility explicitly, and confirm sharing before exposing sensitive notes.
Preserve the supplied facts and confirm the exact note before editing or deleting it.
anti_patterns: Adding inferred customer commitments or unsupported facts to a note.
Sharing private notes without an explicit request.
Editing or deleting another person's note, or selecting a record from an ambiguous name.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It guides creation, editing, visibility changes, and deletion of notes attached to company, contact, or deal records.

faq.question: Does it work without SoftSync tools?
faq.answer: No. It requires the manage_notes tool, plus the messages skill for note discovery and a way to look up records.

faq.question: How are existing notes found?
faq.answer: The instructions direct the assistant to use the messages skill and identify messages from the notes source.

faq.question: Who can edit or delete a note?
faq.answer: The skill states that only the author can edit or delete a note. The tool implementation must enforce those permissions.

faq.question: Can notes remain private?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented actions support private notes and switching visibility between private and shared with the workspace.

faq.question: Can deleted notes be recovered?
faq.answer: No recovery workflow is documented. Confirm the selected note and deletion request before proceeding.
